verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device for human-presence-based MFA/passkeys/PIV/SSH — it authenticates a person via touch, PIN, or physical possession. It has no concept of issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an autonomous agent (a distinct IAM/OAuth-style capability); its APIs (ykman, YubiEnterprise fleet API, python-fido2) manage the physical device itself, not agent-scoped credentials. This is a category mismatch, not a missing feature.
